desc:
🍢 Let's go on a food trip! Roll it, stock it, sell it... and RULE the street! 🔥

Start small and turn your plot into the busiest food market in town, where every regular lines up for a taste. Can you become the ultimate street food legend? 👑

🎰 HOW TO PLAY 🎰
🎲 Roll for fishball, isaw, kwek kwek & MORE
🥡 Stock your stalls with your best finds
💸 Your stalls sell to hungry customers and rake in the cash
🏪 Buy new stalls and set them up on your plot to grow your market
🌟 The rarer the food, the BIGGER the profits... all the way up to the ultimate ✨SECRET✨ tier!

💤 OFFLINE EARNINGS: Your stalls keep selling even while you're away
⛈️🌈 LIMITED TIME FESTIVALS 🌈⛈️
